title: One measurement set in the existing Wwox-null / neuronal-rescue mouse cohort that separates an endocrine IGF-1 deficit from growth failure secondary to seizures, feeding or metabolic derangement, and from a tissue-autonomous effect: serum IGF-1 and GH read against weight-matched controls
source: harness-engineering (plan), DREAM-3 pilot 2026-11-08; disease-models/wwox/research/dream3_20261108/ (README); rows already in the repository: the lde/lde growth premise and its unfired revival trigger (c) (dismissal_ledger_current.md, entry on the GH premise, PMID 17803050 'not significant' GH difference); PMID 34747138 dossier (hypoglycaemia and growth failure rescued by neuronal AAV; IGF-1 not stated; tissue of origin ambiguous); analysis/DISCOVERY_TRACE_metabolic_gating_20260922.md (hypoglycaemia is one limb of a multi-system derangement; lde/lde uremic without hypoglycaemia); a muscle-specific deletion with a cell-autonomous glucose phenotype cited in the PMID 34747138 Discussion
causal_statement: IPOTESI: the growth failure of two WWOX-deficient models (lde/lde rat; Wwox-null mouse) has been explained by glucose, by GH and by neuronal loss in separate notes, and no source in the repository measures the IGF axis in either; low IGF-1 would fit an endocrine deficit, a consequence of malnutrition or seizures, or a cell-autonomous skeletal or muscle effect, and the three are separated by the same readout only if serum IGF-1 and GH are measured together in animals matched for body weight and feeding: low IGF-1 with high GH points to GH resistance (consequence), low IGF-1 with low GH to a pituitary or hypothalamic origin, normal IGF-1 with small size to a local effect; the combination of these rows around one unmeasured axis is new in the repository.
falsifier: Serum IGF-1 and GH within the wild-type range in untreated Wwox-null pups at a stage when growth is already reduced, with body weight, feeding and fed glucose recorded (no endocrine arm to separate); or IGF-1 low in null pups and equally low in wild-type pups made small by restricted feeding or seizure burden, so that the axis follows size and not genotype.
transfer_limit: the repository holds no IGF-axis measurement in any WWOX-deficient animal; the lde/lde GH result is a small-sample non-significant difference, not a normal value; PMID 34747138 glucose is a single tail-prick reading with unstated fed state and the rescue covers glucose, seizures, feeding and growth together, so it does not say which one the neurons act on; the human GWAS lists naming IGF1 or IGFBP7 beside WWOX (PMID 22479346, PMID 28763065) are separate loci in one sentence and carry no WWOX-IGF link; an IGF-1 and microglia result in a myelination model (another package) is a different context and is not used here as support; a mouse and a rat model are not the human genotype class; no direction is carried to a compound and nothing here changes a need, a card or the ranking. Not medical advice.
